name: Acme Logs
one_liner: A command-line tool that searches and tails logs from several servers at once in one terminal.
what_it_does: Tails log files from many servers over SSH in one stream
Searches logs across servers with one command
Highlights and filters lines by pattern
Works without installing an agent on the servers
who_it_is_for: Developers and operators who run a handful of servers
Small teams without a central logging system
problems_solved: Opening many SSH sessions to read logs
Searching the same error across several machines
Following a request through logs on multiple servers
pricing: Open source, with a paid support plan.
buyer_phrases: lightweight alternative to a logging stack
without setting up a log server
best_customer: A developer running three to ten servers who does not want to operate a full logging stack.
misconceptions: People expect it to store logs and draw charts. It reads logs where they already are.
never_reply_to: Questions about metrics dashboards or tracing.
